001package dev.nandi0813.api.Event;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.PlayerState;
004import lombok.Getter;
005import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
006import org.bukkit.event.Event;
007import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
008
009import java.util.UUID;
010
011/**
012 * Fired on the main thread when a player's {@link PlayerState} changes. Fired only when {@code from != to}.
013 * Not cancellable.
014 */
015@Getter
016public class PlayerStateChangeEvent extends Event {
017
018    private static final HandlerList handlers = new HandlerList();
019
020    /** The id of the player, never null. */
021    private final UUID playerId;
022    /** The player, or null when the player is offline (for example {@code to == OFFLINE} on quit). */
023    private final Player player;
024    /** The previous state, never null. */
025    private final PlayerState from;
026    /** The new state, never null. */
027    private final PlayerState to;
028
029    /**
030     * Create a new player state change event.
031     * @param playerId The id of the player
032     * @param player The player, or null when the player is offline
033     * @param from The previous state
034     * @param to The new state
035     */
036    public PlayerStateChangeEvent(UUID playerId, Player player, PlayerState from, PlayerState to) {
037        this.playerId = playerId;
038        this.player = player;
039        this.from = from;
040        this.to = to;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public HandlerList getHandlers() {
045        return handlers;
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Get the handler list of this event.
050     * @return The handler list
051     */
052    public static HandlerList getHandlerList() {
053        return handlers;
054    }
055
056}
